[[Spawning Power]] | damagetype = [[Fire damage]] | unique = yes }} [[Xun Rao's Justice]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[wand]] dropped by [[Imperial Guard Lockbox]]es. ==Stats== :[[Fire damage|Fire Dmg]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Divine Favor]]) :Fire Dmg: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Fast Casting]]) :Fire Dmg: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Soul Reaping]]) :Fire Dmg: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Energy Storage]]) :Fire Dmg: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Spawning Power]]) :[[Energy]] +5 (while Health is above 50%) :[[HSR|Halves skill recharge]] of [[spell]]s (Chance: 10%) ==Replica== Except for the visual appearance and [[damage type]], it is possible to create a replica of this wand with the same stats. Replicas will cause the damage type associated with the inherent [[attribute]].
